components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink ground, paper text, square corners, uppercase label.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0E0E0E; color: #F7F4EE; border: 2px solid #0E0E0E; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Manrope', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 14px 28px; transition: background 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #C9352B; border-color: #C9352B; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C9352B; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Paper-2 ground, 1px ink border, square corners.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #EFEAE0; color: #0E0E0E; border: 1px solid #0E0E0E; border-radius: 0; padding: 10px 14px; font-family: 'Manrope', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C9352B; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Upload Zone
components.html: PDF 파일을 끌어다 놓거나 클릭하여 선택
components.css: .ds-upload { background: #EFEAE0; color: #5A5650; border: 2px dashed #0E0E0E; border-radius: 0; padding: 24px; min-height: 140px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-family: 'Manrope', system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 180ms ease, background 180ms ease; } .ds-upload:hover { border-color: #C9352B; background: #FFFFFF; }

narrative.overview: A mid-century magazine identity for a local print tool: black ink on warm coated stock, one vermilion spot color, a serif masthead over a strict two-column grid, drop initials, and heavy rules. The interface refuses the default Gradio card stack and the generic hero-over-features template; every screen reads like a press sheet. Calm, precise, trustworthy.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground (#F7F4EE) with ink (#0E0E0E) text; one spot color (vermilion #C9352B) used sparingly.
Bodoni Moda serif for display and headlines; Manrope for UI and body.
Zero radius: all corners are square; rules (1px/3px) carry structure.
Two-column fold on desktop; single column on mobile.
Hidden silhouette mark revealed on hover (footer).

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: The vermilion spot appears on at most one element per viewport; its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; emphasis comes from rules and tonal steps, not shadows.

dos: Do keep corners square and rules heavy.
Do use vermilion on at most one element per viewport.
Do fold two columns to one on mobile.
Do keep the upload → convert → download flow visible without scrolling.
donts: Don't use rounded corners or pill buttons.
Don't use an eyebrow/kicker above the masthead.
Don't let the convert action leave the first viewport.
